parallel.requirements: Recognized the ESM/.mjs, manual argv, zero-dependency, /output placement, bech32 decode, convertbits, and executable-comparison requirements. It also discovered that the executable rejected bech32m, but that fact was not correctly preserved in the library child brief.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent probed behavior, then used AgentSwarm with two owners: agent-0 for Bech32 library modules and agent-1 for the entry file. Parent retained integration and final verification ownership.
parallel.implementation: Agent-0 wrote /output/bech32/encoding.mjs, convertbits.mjs, and decode.mjs. Agent-1 wrote /output/test12.mjs. Parent later edited decode.mjs to reject bech32m and remove bech32m version checks.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The child outputs landed in the same /output tree and the parent listed final files. Artifact validation copied test12.mjs and the three Bech32 modules.
parallel.verification: Children ran syntax, behavioral, and argparse checks. Parent reran a 19-case address comparison, corrected a harness issue in argparse checks, ran a clean grep for prohibited constructs, and executed a sample.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed, passing only 3 of 70 cases. The trajectory does not expose detailed official failure cases, so the remaining implementation defect is ordinary or evaluator-hidden rather than a separately evidenced coordination label.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same task prompt and probed bech32, argv, output formatting, ESM, and /output requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single main agent kept all ownership locally. It created a todo list, performed executable probes, then entered plan mode before implementation.
serial.implementation: No deliverable implementation was written to /output. The only write was a plan file under the agent home describing a proposed multi-module ESM implementation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No /output artifact files were copied; artifact validation records an empty files list and missing expected entry.
serial.verification: Serial ran many executable probes, including valid/invalid address cases and argparse help/error behavior, but performed no post-implementation verification because it never implemented.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run waited on plan-mode approval until cancellation, timed out, and closed with no submitted artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the required ESM files, .mjs suffixes, /output placement, manual process.argv parsing, no external dependencies, and executable-based behavioral matching.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same prompt and task obligations before planning a local implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized top-level requirements were materially similar; the later difference was execution, with parallel turning them into files and serial stopping at planning.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split the work between a library child and an entry-file child while the parent kept final integration and testing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not delegate; the single agent owned probing, design, planned implementation, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel achieved an implemented artifact through child ownership, while serial's single-owner path stalled in plan mode before implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent supplied a library/entry interface contract, but the library child brief omitted the already observed executable fact that valid bech32m should be rejected for parity, causing an initial library mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept behavior probes and the proposed implementation plan in one context, with no child brief or inter-agent transfer boundary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a child-brief context error around bech32m behavior; serial avoided that boundary but then failed for a non-concurrency reason before coding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote concrete modules and entry code, then parent-edited decode.mjs after detecting the bech32m mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial probed behavior and wrote a plan for modules under /output/lib plus test12.mjs, but no actual output implementation reached the artifact directory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced code; serial produced only a plan.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Both children completed and their aggregate AgentSwarm result returned to the parent. The parent consumed it and continued.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results; the main turn was interrupted while an ExitPlanMode approval was pending.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a complete child-result lifecycle; serial's own local lifecycle stopped at approval/cancellation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child files were assembled in /output, then the parent edited the library and confirmed final file/import layout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No /output code files reached artifact validation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel integrated a shared output tree; serial had no deliverable to integrate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local differential address tests, corrected an argparse harness artifact, then ran final file/import checks before closing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran executable probes and argparse observations before implementation, but no implemented artifact was available for whole-task verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verified a submitted artifact locally but still failed hidden official tests; serial had only preimplementation probes and official failure from no artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed the agent turn in about 857 seconds and the cell in about 915 seconds without timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed the full provider budget, timed out after about 2408 agent seconds, and was cancelled while approval was pending.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed with a submitted artifact; serial closed by timeout/cancellation before implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail: parallel failed despite producing an artifact and passing 3 of 70 cases, while serial failed with 0 of 70 because it timed out after entering plan mode and delivered no artifact. The concrete difference is not a discordant pass/fail result. Parallel had enough coordination to create and verify code, but one child brief transferred the bech32m/executable behavior incorrectly and caused parent-side rework; serial avoided child coordination but never implemented after its planning checkpoint.
parallel_contributors: Parallel child division produced the required entry and library files.
The library child followed an incomplete bech32m brief, and the parent spent later work detecting and patching that mismatch.
Local verification did not expose the remaining official failures beyond 3 of 70 passed.
serial_contributors: Serial performed useful executable and argparse probing.
Serial entered plan mode and waited for approval until cancellation, leaving the artifact directory empty.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel's hidden official failures after local checks are not fully explained by raw evaluator details in the mounted pair.
Serial's no-artifact failure is a process/approval timeout in the single-agent control, not a parallel coordination pattern.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
